title: Toddler Boy in Plaid Overalls Outdoors, 1969 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white square snapshot photo dated July 1969, featuring a young toddler wearing a plaid jumper or overalls over a short-sleeved white collared shirt. The child is standing outdoors on a paved area with painted lines, likely a playground or schoolyard, backed by a chain-link fence, suburban homes, utility poles, and rolling hills in the distance.
